title: Vegetarian Turkish-Style Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: A twist on traditional Turkish kebabs, this recipe features roasted bell peppers stuffed with a flavorful mix of rice, herbs, and spices, all vegetarian and perfectly suited for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
In a large bowl, combine rice, onions, parsley, oregano, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Stuff each bell pepper with the rice mixture, filling to the top.
Drizzle with olive oil and cover with aluminum foil.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
